source.author: verg
source.text: Tu Maxumus ille es, unus qui nobis cunctando restituis rem.
source.text_original: Tu Maxumus ille es, / unus qui nobis cunctando restituis rem.
source.text_english: You are that Maximus, the one man who by delaying restores our fortunes to us.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: alius forsitan scholae memor Quintum Maximum, unus qui nobis cunctando restituit rem, et totam Fabiorum gentem proferret in medium, diceret pugnas, describeret proelia et per tantae nobilitatis gradus Fabiolam uenisse iactaret, ut, quod in uirga non poterat, in radicibus demonstraret.
reuse.text_original: alius forsitan scholae memor Quintum Maximum, unus qui nobis cunctando restituit rem, et totam Fabiorum gentem proferret in medium, diceret pugnas, describeret proelia et per tantae nobilitatis gradus Fabiolam uenisse iactaret, ut, quod in uirga non poterat, in radicibus demonstraret.
reuse.text_english: Perhaps another, remembering school, would bring Quintus Maximus, the one man who restored our state to us by delaying, and would produce the whole line of the Fabii, would recount battles, describe engagements, and boast that Fabiola had come down through the stages of so great a nobility, so that what could not be shown in the branch might be shown in the roots.
